implementation.targetScope: Capacitor archive cleanup and the async/sync string-path removal, opt-in glob, filter, cancellation and retry APIs. Built-in fs removal for plain cleanup; independently written postorder traversal for filters and signals.

differences: Root protection cannot be disabled; complete input batches are validated before removal.
Duplicate and overlapping roots are collapsed and independent roots run sequentially.
Synchronous promise filters and malformed retry values reject explicitly.
Named implementation strategies, interactive CLI, legacy callbacks and Windows move/remove fallbacks are outside scope.
Path identity checks reduce observed replacement hazards but do not create an atomic filesystem sandbox.
No application adoption or public release claimed.
